column1: # Book 4 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 4.438 ros salis is the brine, the water line, not spray.
# 4.486-487 aures and tactus are the subjects: the ears correct the eyes, touch corrects the ears. The English had both reversed.

column2: For whatever part of the oars is raised above the brine
Or will the ears be able to correct the eyes, or touch
the ears? Or again will the mouth's taste accuse this touch,
